name: xdr-boost
title: XDR Boost
description: Make SDR content brighter on XDR displays by using their extra EDR headroom.
author: chrismessina

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Show XDR Boost in Menu Bar
commands.description: Show the boost in the menu bar and change its level from there.

commands.name: toggle-boost
commands.title: Toggle XDR Boost
commands.description: Turn the boost on at your default level, or turn it off.

commands.name: increase-boost
commands.title: Increase Boost
commands.description: Step each display up one preset from its own level.

commands.name: decrease-boost
commands.title: Decrease Boost
commands.description: Step each display down one preset from its own level, down to off.

commands.name: set-boost
commands.title: Set XDR Boost
commands.description: Pick a level for all displays or for one connected XDR display.

commands.name: quick-set-boost
commands.title: Quick Set XDR Boost
commands.description: Set every XDR display to a level from 1.0 to 1.75, a percent, or a preset name.

tools.name: set-boost
tools.title: Set Boost
tools.description: Set the XDR brightness boost for every display, or for one display by name, from 1.0 (off) to 1.75 (maximum).

tools.name: get-boost
tools.title: Get Boost
tools.description: Report each connected XDR display's boost level and status.

preferences.name: defaultLevel
preferences.title: Default Level
preferences.description: The level Toggle XDR Boost turns on.

preferences.name: restoreAfterRestart
preferences.title: After Restart
preferences.label: Restore the boost after a restart
preferences.description: The menu bar command restarts the boost at your last level.

preferences.name: boostStrategy
preferences.title: Boost Strategy
preferences.description: Follow Brightness raises Max as you lower the brightness slider.

preferences.name: externalMax
preferences.title: External XDR Maximum
preferences.description: Fixed Maximum only: light boost at Max on external XDR displays.

data.title: 3.4× (Full, may blank a Pro Display XDR)

preferences.name: pauseBelowBattery
preferences.title: Pause When Battery Below
preferences.description: On battery power, pause the boost below this charge.

preferences.name: notifyOnChange
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Show a notification when the boost changes
preferences.description: Posts a macOS notification with the new level after every change.
